needs.proposedSignature: AltCost: { id: 'disturb'; label: string; cost: AbilityCost; from: 'graveyard'; transformed: true }  // plus AltCostId += 'disturb' and a COVER_RULES shape ^disturb (\{.+\})$
needs.semantics: An alternative cost that casts the card from its owner's graveyard with its BACK face up (CR 702.147a); if it would leave the stack it is exiled instead. Needs a `transformed` flag on AltCost (or an `entersAs: 'back'`) so `castSpell` puts the back face onto the battlefield, and a covers kind so the printed 'Disturb {1}{W}' line is claimed by the declaration rather than by an ability.

'At the beginning of your upkeep, create a token that's a copy of enchanted creature, except it's a Spirit in addition to its other types.' `token-copy.target` is `TargetSpec | 'that' | 'self'` only, so an Aura cannot copy the permanent it is attached to; widening it to the composition-core Ref union (which every other object op already accepts) is the whole fix, and `extraSubtypes` already covers the 'except' clause.
needs.clause: // At the beginning of your upkeep, create a token that's a copy of enchanted creature, except it's a Spirit in addition to its other types.
